doc.title: Jane Bunnett interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 25, 2024

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well young musicians will be holding up your records and say, “I played with Jane.” So thank you for your time. This has been delightful.
Monk, thank you. I really enjoyed it and I hope we get to meet in person sometime soon. That would be so great.
Right. Best of luck with you and your group and Larry.
Thank you. Thanks a lot. Keep in touch, okay, and I’ll continue to watch your awesome video interviews.
Okay. Thanks so much. © Fillius Jazz Archive -18-
